caption:
DAN DAN NOODLES 🍜
If you like spicy, saucy noodles, you NEED to make these.
510 CAL | 38G PROTEIN | 43G CARBS | 23G FAT
SERVES 3

INGREDIENTS
Noodles + greens
* 120g @masterchow.in udon noodles, raw
* 1 bunch bok choy (or spinach / any greens)
Chicken
* 450g @licious_foods chicken mince
* 1 tbsp ginger, chopped
* 1 tbsp garlic, chopped
* 1 tbsp soy sauce
* ½ tbsp oyster sauce
* 1 tbsp vinegar
* Salt + pepper
Dan Dan sauce
* 1½ tbsp garlic, finely chopped
* 1 tbsp chilli flakes
* 2 tbsp sesame seeds
* 1 tbsp sesame oil (15ml)
* 1 tbsp dark soy
* 1½ tbsp light soy
* 1 tbsp oyster sauce
* 2 tbsp rice wine vinegar
* 2½ tbsp peanut butter
* 1 tbsp schezuan sauce, adjust to taste
* ½ tbsp jaggery, optional
* ¼ cup vegetable stock or warm water
Garnish: spring onion greens + sesame seeds

METHOD
Poach the greens and cook the udon according to the packet. Set aside.
Cook the chicken mince, breaking it up well. Add ginger, garlic, soy, oyster sauce, vinegar, salt + pepper. Turn up the heat and cook until dry and slightly caramelised.
For the sauce, add garlic, chilli + sesame seeds to a bowl. Pour over hot sesame oil and let it sizzle for 15 seconds. Add remaining sauce ingredients and mix. Loosen with stock/warm water.
Layer sauce, noodles, chicken + greens in a bowl. Finish with spring onions + sesame seeds.

VEG ALTERNATIVES 🌱
Mushrooms: 500–600g, finely chopped. Cook until the moisture evaporates and they’re browned, then season as above.
Tofu: 300–350g firm tofu, crumbled and cooked until golden.
Paneer: 300–350g paneer, crumbled and lightly browned.
Traditionally Dan Dan noodles use Sichuan peppercorns — I didn’t have any, but these were still SO good. Chunky peanut butter is my preference for texture, but smooth works too.

SAVE this for your next noodle craving & SHARE it with someone who loves noodles! 🤍
